newsitem.title: USA: Union Texas new La. furnace to raise output.
newsitem.headline: Union Texas new La. furnace to raise output.

text.p: Union Texas Petroleum Holdings Inc said Monday it will build a new furnace and upgrade nine others to increase ethylene production at its Geismar, Louisiana, plant by 2 percent.
The improvements will cost about $27.8 million, including Union Texas's $11.6 million share, the company said.

Union Texas operates the plant and has a 41.67 percent interest in it. The company said BASF AG holds 41.67 percent interest, and GE Plastics, a unit of General Electric Co holds 16.66 percent interest in the facility.
Union Texas said the changes should raise annual production by about 26 million gross pounds to about 1.275 billion gross pounds.
The improvements should begin in May, 1997 and end in February, 1999, the company said. It said the new furnace should begin operating in the fourth quarter 1997.
